page_title: LEC 1-0 TOR | Lecce v Torino 18/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
88' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) is adjudged offside.
87' The players claim that Che Adams (Torino) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
86' Ante Rebic (Lecce) is caught offside!
86' Marco Giampaolo prepares a substitution. Frederic Guilbert is replaced by Danilo Veiga (Lecce).
85' It will be a substitution. Marcus Pedersen (Torino) is ready to enter the pitch as Ali Dembele walks off.
84' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
82' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) produces a poor free kick which sails wide.
78' Antonio Rapuano shows the yellow card to Tete Morente (Lecce) for a heavy challenge.
75' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Cesare Casadei (Torino) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
71' Substitution. Valentino Lazaro makes his way off the pitch and Alessio Cacciamani (Torino) comes on as his replacement.
71' Paolo Vanoli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Antonio Sanabria (Torino) replacing Nikola Vlasic.
70' Substitution. Ivan Ilic (Torino) in, Samuele Ricci out.
70' A lofted cross finds an unmarked Cesare Casadei (Torino), who leaps high and powers a header at goal. However, his header goes miles away of the left post. Poor effort.
69' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Ante Rebic (Lecce), whose good effort would probably have ended inside the bottom right corner of the net.
68' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes well past the right post.
67' Torino have been awarded a corner kick.
67' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
59' Here is a change. Gvidas Gineitis is going off and Paolo Vanoli gives the last tactical orders to Sergiu Perciun (Torino).
59' Nikola Krstovic is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Mohamed Kaba (Lecce).
55' The possession of the ball – 46:54.
50' The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
49' Lecce have a corner.
49' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Nikola Krstovic (Lecce), whose good effort would probably have ended inside the right post.
46' 1 - 0 Absolutely fantastic goal! Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) hits a perfect volley from far out and the ball flies into the top left corner. Take a bow.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) is replaced by Santiago Pierotti.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Marco Giampaolo gives a chance to Ante Rebic and Konan Ndri (Lecce) is off.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+3' What a poor attempt! Tete Morente (Lecce) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
45+2' The game is interrupted now, Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Balthazar Pierret is substituted due to injury. Marco Giampaolo gives a chance to Ylber Ramadani (Lecce).
43' Balthazar Pierret (Lecce) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
42' Cesare Casadei (Torino) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Wladimiro Falcone was alert and made a comfortable save.
39' Lecce win a corner.
39' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) unleashes a first-time shot which stings the gloves of the goalkeeper.
39' A cross from Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
37' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) spurns a big chance! He makes himself some space to meet a cross and from near the penalty spot sends a header well wide of the left post!
32' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lecce, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
31' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
31' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) will take a corner kick.
28' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
26' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) is penalised for holding. Antonio Rapuano signals a set piece.
23' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) tries his luck with a shot, but his effort goes wide of the target.
20' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
18' Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) heads the ball towards goal, but the goalkeeper denies his effort by making an easy save.
17' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lecce.
17' Konan Ndri (Lecce) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
16' Flag up against Che Adams (Torino). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
16' A lofted cross finds an unmarked Ali Dembele (Torino), who leaps high and powers a header at goal. However, his header goes miles past the right post. Poor effort.
15' The goalkeeper pulls off a save to deny Ali Dembele (Torino), whose effort is only aimed at the middle of the goal.
14' Torino have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
14' The attempt by Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) isn't very precise and Wladimiro Falcone stops it with ease.
13' Handball by Nikola Krstovic (Lecce).
9' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
7' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
6' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
4' Dangerous play by Cesare Casadei (Torino). Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle for a foul.
